FormModule.Comment:
module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Monday 08 September 2008 9:44:55 Copyright (c) 1993 BloodCare,
 9000 Harry Hines Blvd
 Dallas, TX 75235
 All Rights Reserved
This form is the menu system for displaying and executing system functions
for authorized users. Each menu can display up to 99 selections, but the
selections shown to each user are only those which the user is permitted
to execute (by virtue of mapping the user's access level for each function
group to the function group/access level required to execute each menu
selection.
Users may choose a selection by entering the number shown to the left of
the chosen selection (to execute a selection on the current menu), or by
entering the keyword associated with their choice (this allows access to
any authorized selection, regardless of menu).
The menu system can execute forms (in query-only or data-entry modes),
Sql scripts, shell scripts, HOST commands, and can display an unlimited
hierarchy of menus.

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--
-- check if any startup form for the application
-- If yes, start the form. The form will set global.startup_form_status
-- to a nonnull value as SUCCESS. If global is still null, return to
-- application menu.
--
 if :appl.startup_form_name is not null
 then
 :global.startup_form_status := '';
 --message(:appl.startup_form_name);
 CALL_FORM( lower(:appl.startup_form_name) ,no_hide ,no_replace);
 erase_globals;
 if not form_success
 then
 message ('Err: Startup form '|| :appl.startup_form_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :global.startup_form_status is null
 then
 return;
 end if;
 end if;

 go_block('user_menu');
 clear_block(no_validate);
--

 check_package_failure;
 synchronize;
 GO_ITEM ('MENU_SELECT.SELECTION');
 
 SHOW_VIEW('VT');
end;

Trigger.Name: PROCESS_SELECTION
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 remarks_1 VARCHAR2(60);
 remarks_2 VARCHAR2(60);
begin
 if :global.numeric = 'YES'
 then

 then
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('user_menu.descrip','Inverse');

 execute_trigger('exec_PREV');
 check_package_failure;

 then

 else

Trigger.Name: PROCESS_MNEMONIC
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dot1 number;
 dot_appl VARCHAR2(4);
 dot_keyword VARCHAR2(8);
begin
 begin
 dot1 := instr(:menu_select.selection,'.',1,1);
 if dot1 > 0 then
 dot_appl := substr(:menu_select.selection,1,dot1-1);
 dot_keyword := substr(:menu_select.selection,dot1+1);
 end if;
 exception
 when others then null;
 end;
 Select FCN_TYPE,
 EXEC_NAME,
 P1_NAME, P2_NAME,
 P3_NAME, P1_VALUE,
 P2_VALUE, P3_VALUE,
 HOST_CMD, FCN_ID,
 descrip ,
 mnemonic ,
 decode(fcn_type,'MENU',menu_id,:menu_select.menu_id)
 into :MENU_SELECT.FCN_TYPE,
 :MENU_SELECT.EXEC_NAME,
 :MENU_SELECT.P1_NAME, :MENU_SELECT.P2_NAME,
 :MENU_SELECT.P3_NAME, :MENU_SELECT.P1_VALUE,
 :MENU_SELECT.P2_VALUE, :MENU_SELECT.P3_VALUE,
 :MENU_SELECT.HOST_CMD, :MENU_SELECT.FCN_ID,
 :menu_select.descrip,
 :menu_select.mnemonic,
 :menu_select.menu_id
 from USER_MENU
 where MNEMONIC = nvl(dot_keyword,:MENU_SELECT.selection)
 and appl_id = nvl(dot_appl,:global.appl_id);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Selection not found, please choose again.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
--
execute_trigger('FIND_SELECTION');
check_package_failure;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NEWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_news is
 no_of_items number(4);
 plural_ind VARCHAR2(1);
--
begin
 begin
 select count(*) , decode(count(*),1,'','s')
 into no_of_items , plural_ind
 from news_status
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and trunc(sysdate) between eff_date and term_date
 and not exists
 ( select 'x'
 from news_log
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and news_id = news_status.news_id
 and user_id = :banner.user_id );
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 --
 if no_of_items > 0
 then
 :global.hlp_conf_msg := 'You have ' || to_char(no_of_items)
 || ' New News Item' || plural_ind
 || '. Do you want to view ? ';
 bell;
 CALL_FORM( lower('DIAHLP') ,no_hide);
 erase_globals;
 if :global.hlp_conf_ind = 'Y'
 then
 CALL_FORM( lower('GENNEWS'));
 erase_globals;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SEPARATE_REMARKS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure separate_remarks ( remarks in VARCHAR2 ,
 remarks_1 out VARCHAR2,
 remarks_2 out VARCHAR2 ) is
 position number(2);
begin
 if nvl(substr(remarks,60,1),' ') = ' ' or
 nvl(substr(remarks,61,1),' ') = ' '
 then
 remarks_1 := substr(remarks,1,60);
 remarks_2 := ltrim(substr(remarks,61));
 else
 position := instr(substr(remarks,1,60),' ',-1);
 remarks_1 := substr(remarks,1,position);
 remarks_2 := substr(remarks,position+1,60);
 end if;
end;

PACKAGE BODY KTRAK IS
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION Is_Integrated RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_cur_found BOOLEAN;
 cursor c_ktrak_integrated
 is
 select 1 dummy_value
 from lt_application_config
 where upper(appl_id) = 'LIFETRAK'
 and UPPER(NVL(ktrak_integrated,'N')) = 'Y';
 BEGIN
 
 open c_ktrak_integrated;
 fetch c_ktrak_integrated into l_dummy;
 l_cur_found := c_ktrak_integrated%FOUND;
 close c_ktrak_integrated;
 
 return l_cur_found;
 
 END;
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 PROCEDURE call_DE_cmd(cmd_in IN VARCHAR2, error_code OUT VARCHAR2, error_msg OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 v_url VARCHAR2(2000);
 exit_process EXCEPTION;
 BEGIN 
 KTrak_Interface_Lab.call_api_cmd (
 in_cmd => cmd_in,
 out_string => v_url,
 out_errcde => error_code,
 out_errmsg => error_msg
 ); 
 
 IF error_code is not null then
 raise exit_process;
 END IF;
 
 If UPPER(cmd_in) = 'USERSTATUS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_assg_due := KTrak_Interface_Lab.get_xmlnode_value('due-assignments');
 globalvar.g_kt_assg_past_due := KTrak_Interface_Lab.get_xmlnode_value('pastdue-assignments');
 globalvar.g_kt_alerts_due := KTrak_Interface_Lab.get_xmlnode_value('alerts');
 globalvar.g_kt_error := KTrak_Interface_Lab.get_xmlnode_value('error');
 End If;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN exit_process THEN
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 error_code := '94XX';
 error_msg := sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,200);
 END; 
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 PROCEDURE CALL_RIS_CMD(cmd_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 v_url VARCHAR2(2000);
 v_errcde VARCHAR2(100);
 v_errmsg VARCHAR2(2000);
 BEGIN 
 
 KTrak_Interface_Lab.call_api_cmd (
 in_cmd => cmd_in,
 out_string => v_url,
 out_errcde => v_errcde,
 out_errmsg => v_errmsg 
 ); 
 If v_errcde is not null then
 -- Error Code: 94XX is used as internal code and is not defined in error codes definition. 
 if v_errcde = '94XX' then 
 message('Internal Error - ' || v_errmsg);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 show_error(v_errcde, ' - ' || v_errmsg);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;
 
 If UPPER(cmd_in) = 'KTLOGIN' then
 globalvar.g_kt_login_url := v_url;
 Elsif UPPER(cmd_in) = 'DOCUMENTS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_doc_url := v_url;
 Elsif UPPER(cmd_in) = 'ALERTS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_alert_url := v_url;
 Elsif UPPER(cmd_in) = 'ASSIGNMENTS' then
 globalvar.g_kt_assg_url := v_url; 
 End If;
 
 EXCEPTION
 When Form_trigger_failure then
 raise;
 
 When others then

 vcVColor VARCHAR2(11);

 -- Set visited color to be same as active color.

 set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_alerts',background_color,'r173g203b222');
 
 KTRAK.bean_initialized := TRUE; 
 END IF;

 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_DUE',1,'setLabel',globalvar.g_kt_assg_due || ' Items Due,');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_PAST_DUE',1,'setLabel',globalvar.g_kt_assg_past_due || ' Items Past Due,');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ALERTS',1,'setLabel',globalvar.g_kt_alerts_due || ' Alerts');
 
 /*
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_DUE',1,'setNormalColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_DUE',1,'setActiveColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_DUE',1,'setVisitedColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_PAST_DUE',1,'setNormalColor','255 255 255'); 
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_PAST_DUE',1,'setActiveColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_PAST_DUE',1,'setVisitedColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ALERTS',1,'setNormalColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ALERTS',1,'setActiveColor','255 255 255');
 FBean.Invoke('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ALERTS',1,'setVisitedColor','255 255 255'); 
 */
 ELSE 
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('VT.PB_KT_APP', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 HIDE_VIEW('KTRAK_CANVAS');

 --item_change('VT.PB_KT_DOC','D');
 --set_item_property('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_DUE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 --set_item_property('LAF_BLOCK.HYPERLINK_ITEMS_PAST_DUE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 PROCEDURE initialize IS
 v_err_code VARCHAR2(100);
 v_err_msg VARCHAR2(2000);
 exit_process EXCEPTION;
 BEGIN
 IF KTRAK.IS_Integrated THEN 
 
 -- Blue Background -- Background color is set in enable_disable
 /*
 set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_items_due',background_color,'r0g130b231');
 set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_items_past_due',background_color,'r0g130b231');
 set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_alerts',background_color,'r0g130b231');
 */ 
 --set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_items_due',background_color,'r188g210b238');
 --set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_items_past_due',background_color,'r188g210b238');
 --set_item_property('laf_block.hyperlink_alerts',background_color,'r188g210b238');--'r210g226b255'); 
 
 KTRAK.call_DE_cmd('UserStatus', v_err_code, v_err_msg); 
 
 If v_err_code is null then
 -- Check if any errors are returned in XML data. 
 -- globalvar.g_kt_error is populated in call_DE_cmd routine.
 If globalvar.g_kt_error is not null then
 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('D');
 show_error('9404', globalvar.g_kt_error); -- Message type
 check_package_failure;
 Else
 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('E');
 End If;
 Else
 KTRAK.Enable_Disable('D');
 -- Error Code: 94XX is used as internal code and is not defined in error codes definition. 
 if v_err_code = '94XX' then
 message('Internal Error - ' || v_err_msg || ' KnowledgeTrak is disabled');
 raise exit_process;
 elsif v_err_code in ('9400', '9403') then -- 9403: User does not have permission; 9400: KT User ID is not configured.
 show_error(v_err_code, ' KnowledgeTrak is disabled');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 --show_error(v_err_code, v_err_msg); -- IM:9762
 show_error(v_err_code); -- IM:9762
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End If;
 ELSE
 Enable_Disable('D'); -- Added on 01/31/2012; Ashok 
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN form_trigger_failure then
 RAISE; 
 WHEN exit_process then
 NULL;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Err ' ||SQLCODE || ' - ' || SQLERRM);PAUSE; 
 END initialize; 
END;

Trigger.Name: FIND_SELECTION
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 last_rec_no number;
 sel_rec_no number;
 found boolean;
begin
--
 found := FALSE;
--
 if :global.numeric = 'YES'
 then
 :system.message_level := 15;
 go_block ('USER_MENU');
 last_rec_no := :system.cursor_record;
 first_record;
 for i in 1..:n_choices loop
 if :system.trigger_record =
 to_number (:menu_select.selection)
 then
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('user_menu.descrip','Inverse');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('menu_select.dummy_choice','Inverse');

 found := TRUE;
 execute_trigger('copy_fields');
 check_package_failure;
 exit;
 else
 down;
 if not form_success
 then
 go_block('menu_select');
 message ('No options on menu.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 exit;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 else
 last_rec_no := :user_menu.rownum;
 end if;
--
 if found = TRUE
 then
 sel_rec_no := :system.cursor_record;
 if :global.record_pointer = '0'
 then
 :menu_select.dummy_arrow := '';
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('menu_select.dummy_choice','Inverse');
 else
 go_record(last_rec_no);
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('user_menu.descrip','Inverse');
 :user_menu.arrow := '';
 end if;
 go_record(sel_rec_no);
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('user_menu.descrip','Bold-underline');
 :user_menu.arrow := '->';
 :global.record_pointer := sel_rec_no;
 end if;
--
 if :menu_select.fcn_type = 'MENU'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_MENU');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :menu_select.fcn_type = 'FRM'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_frm');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :menu_select.fcn_type = 'SQL'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_sql');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :menu_select.fcn_type = 'QRY'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_qry');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :menu_select.fcn_type = 'COM'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_COM');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :menu_select.fcn_type = 'HOST'
 then
 execute_trigger ('exec_host');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('menu_select');
 message ('Msg: Function type not currently supported.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 --
 synchronize;
 GO_ITEM ('MENU_SELECT.SELECTION');
 --
 break;
 if (:global.numeric = 'YES' or :menu_select.fcn_type = 'MENU')
 then
 null;
 else
 :menu_select.selection := last_rec_no;
 end if;
end;
